player_prompt.intro:
I JoJoJoin-ah Player {player_id} i ni, 5x5 board-ah khelh a ni a, cell 0-24 thleng number a ni.
I turn-ah, cell khaw khat i duh berah i mark dah rawh, entirnan '[12]'.
I CHAMPION ni thei tur a ni, i mark 4 zawn a row-ah dah tur a ni — cell 4 zawn a horizontal, vertical, emaw diagonal a dah tur a ni.
Player {player_id} i nih chuan '{symbol}' i ni; i khingpui chu '{opponent_symbol}' a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A thawn chhuah chu a format dik lo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} hi cell dik a ni lo. 0 leh 24 inkârah awm tûr a ni.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} chuan an mark ({symbol}) cell {cell}-ah a dah.
